summary: Regression smoke pass for cosmetic-only frontend changes (removed console.error in Dashboard.jsx; added eslint-disable comments to 3 useEffect hooks). Verified via curl that all 5 target backend endpoints work as expected, and via Playwright that all 4 routes (/, /transactions, /test, /setup) load with zero JS/console errors. Full end-to-end upload → OCR → mock GPay verify → reply-text pipeline still works. Nothing regressed.
